globalInbox.gettingStartedSubtitle: To begin, we’ll start with your new Juralio inbox. Inbox has three key areas [1] Right here, right now [2] To date [3] To do
globalInbox.rightHereRightNowSubtitle: This is the central point of your inbox. Past activity appears above the bar and future work is below.
globalInbox.toDateSubtitle: Above the bar is a stream of activity on your matters e.g., creation of new content or change of task status.
globalInbox.todoSubtitle: Any tasks due to be finished within the next 30 days on your matters will appear here.
globalInbox.welcomeSubtitle: Juralio is your central hub for handling legal matters. With the goal of making your life better.

home.createContentSubtitleMatterCreator: Add content using the add button. Create matters, tasks, milestones and posts. Posts include notes and links to documents stored on other systems.
home.createContentSubtitleMatterEditor: Add content using the add button. Create tasks, milestones and posts within matters. Posts include notes and links to documents stored on other systems.
home.helpAndGuidesSubtitle: More questions? Read through our help guides. You can also reset this tutorial from your personal settings.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Work in Juralio is expressed as matters. These contain tasks.
home.recentlyViewedSubtitle: On the left, you’ll see a To-do list. There’s also a Recently viewed list to help you quickly go back to matters and tasks.
home.settingsSubtitle: Visit your personal settings to change your account details, avatar and more.
home.switcherSubtitle: The switcher is a quick way to navigate to your matters. Larger matters can be split into workstreams by the matter administrator.
home.templatesSubtitle: From the switcher, you can also find templates. These help you get started quickly with ready made work plans.
home.welcomeSubtitle:
Welcome to Juralio!
Are you ready to map your work and get things done more effectively? Let’s get you started with some basics.

roadmap.expandSubtasksSubtitle: Clicking below any task will display its subtasks. Clicking again will hide them

taskmap.getStartedSubtitle: All the tasks within a workstream can be viewed in the workstream's taskmap. This gives you an overview of the structure, size and status of the workstream.
taskmap.levelATasksSubtitle: Level A tasks commonly represent phases of a workstream. To help you distinguish between phases, there is a wider space between the subtasks of each level A task.
taskmap.structureSubtitle: Tasks can be organised in up to six levels from  A to F. Level B tasks are subtasks of level A tasks and so on.
taskmap.workflowStatusSubtitle: Task colours show their status - not started (yellow), in progress (amber) or done (teal).

timeline.drillingSubtitle: Selecting a subtask will take your view down a level. Selecting the back button will take you up a level. As you drill down, the inbox will be filtered to cover just the current parent task and its subtasks.
timeline.gettingStartedSubtitle: Inbox lets you see notifications and to-dos for the entire workstream as well as visualisation of tasks and their durations
